note: Mute-test bars. OPERATOR DECISIONS ONLY (CLAUDE.md invariant 2). Operational thresholds calibrated on the current production corpus (7 books, 2026-09-28: good films 1-4 dead frames, failing 17-18); re-calibrate when the corpus grows (benchmark: node scripts/quality-benchmark.js).

hardGate.note: OPERATOR DECISIONS ONLY. A gate listed in nonBlocking still runs and is reported as FAIL when it fails, but does not stop the chain and does not trigger auto-fix. Thresholds are unchanged.

11.reason: Gate 11 passed on published books only because of an uncommitted 'Average VIG Floor' block in scripts/lib/visual-intent.js that raised vigScore to >= 2.7 and restaged authored beats (split shots, prop arcs). That block is removed. VIG has not been shown to predict mute-test DEAD frames, so Gate 11 reports FAIL non-blocking until a replacement metric is decided. VIG is recomputed from the final scene, not read from a stored score.

narrativeFirewall.note: OPERATOR DECISIONS ONLY. Scope: preview-ready only; production delivery rules are unchanged.

previewReady.reason: The production firewall status FAILs on any REVIEW finding; every recent book had 300-500 REVIEW findings (mostly the fallback-lever class, which asks for a shot the author did not choose). Measured on Beloved run1, the firewall flagged 27/30 frames with 37% precision for DEAD/WRONG, so REVIEW does not predict a failed preview. preview-ready now requires 0 BLOCK; REVIEW findings stay in the report and are shown as quality debt. The blind mute test remains the verdict.
